title: LexisNexis Usage and Data Sharing Audit

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

This is a follow up request relating to Accurint Virtual Crime Center & LexisNexis. Our goal is to understand how your agency shares data with LexisNexis (if at all), who accesses your agency's data, and how your agency's personnel query tools provided by LexisNexis. 

1) Audit of how your data is used: An audit export of how other agencies are accessing and using your department's data. Timeframe: The 30 days preceding the time that this request is fulfilled. 
2) Audit of your agency's queries: An audit of your agency's queries of the AVCC system, from the date this request is fulfilled and the 30 days preceding.

Both requests are limited to 30 days and should be within the retention period as they are the 30 days directly preceding the date this request is processed. Thank you!

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal

title: Dakota County, MN - LexisNexis / AVCC Audit

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

A previous public records requested showed that DCSO is sharing CAD & RMS data with LexisNexis for inclusion in their Accurint Virtual Crime Center (AVCC) product. This request seeks to better understand who has access to that data once it's been copied to the data broker, and how it is used. To that end, we are requesting the following records:

1) Signed/Executed "AVCC XML Addendum" (sometimes just "XML Addendum" or similar). This includes the clause that dictates how LexisNexis may share DCSO's local data. An example may be found here: https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/28549832-san-luis-obispo-avcc-addendum/?mode=document#document/p1/a2826398

2) Audit logs from AVCC of outside agencies querying DCSO data. Typically this is only accessible to AVCC/ACA administrators. From our understanding, the system only keeps 30 or 90 days of records, however if a longer audit log timeframe is available, we'd like to request audit logs from 12/1/2025 through present. Please include the agency who searched/accessed DCSO data, and any reason code or information they may have included.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
